name: umo-agentic-core
description: Marketplace core for UMO agentic delivery: SDLC lifecycle, planning with beads, memory workflow, docs lifecycle, quality evidence, review protocol, closeout, adoption modes, and KPI reporting guidance.

validationRules: non-core plugins must depend on umo-agentic-core
non-core plugins must delegate lifecycle, memory, planning, quality, review, and closeout surfaces to umo-agentic-core
no plugin may claim planning or beads-planning-substrate in v1
duplicate ownership surfaces fail validation unless one plugin delegates the surface
plugins may strengthen core invariants but must not weaken or replace them
generated reports must include active plugin names and versions
